Centipeder.name: Centipeder
Centipeder.basicInfo:
Centipeder (Juzo Moashi), a sidekick at Sir Nighteye's agency: courteous and methodical, he runs its surveillance and its restraints. A tall heteromorph with a red, segmented centipede head on a long neck and no human face; a black tailcoat, ruffled white shirt, white gloves.
Speaking Style: Polite, measured, formal even with suspects.
Combat Role: Reach and restraint with long, extendable limbs.
Under Pressure: Stays orderly, secures the threat and reports precisely.
Centipeder.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most unsettling-looking person in most rooms is also the most courteous; people react to the body and miss the gentleman. Connections: Sir Nighteye (Mirai Sasaki), whose meticulous method suits him; Bubble Girl (Kaoruko Awata), whose distractions set up his restraints; Mirio Togata, the U.A. third-year who trains there. Knowledge: Who meets whom, when and where; he reports what he saw and guesses at nothing.
QUIRK: Centipede. A centipede heteromorph body with long, extendable limbs.
personality: Courteous: Proper forms of address for suspects and civilians alike.
Methodical: Patient observation and an ordered plan over improvisation.
Unflustered: Lets stares pass and calms frightened people.
Speaking style: Formal, clear, economical; polite even mid-arrest.
abilities: Limb restraint: Wraps and pins a target; a much stronger one or a cutting Quirk breaks free.
Surveillance: Tails a target for days and logs every contact.
Fighting style: Waits for a partner's distraction, then wraps and pins; restraint over damage.
Centipeder.visualDescription: A tall heteromorph man with a red, segmented centipede head on a long, forward-bending neck, two long antennae, rows of fine insect legs along his head and neck, and no human face. He wears a black formal tailcoat, a ruffled white shirt and white gloves, neat and spotless. Calm, courteous air despite his unsettling look.
